data.title: Agent Learning Hub course requirements
data.text: Stage 0 distinguishes chatbot, workflow and agent. A workflow uses predefined paths; an agent chooses next actions based on observations. Stage 1 requires a minimal bounded tool loop. Stage 2 requires a research assistant that searches, reads and cites sources. Stage 3 studies one harness. Stage 4 compares coordinated roles with a single agent. Stage 5 packages a skill and measures it. Stage 6 is a public-page browser agent. Stage 7 requires at least 20 fixed evaluation tasks with expected and actual results and failure categories. Stage 8 delivers a runnable project.
